description: This file is a header file for the CanIf module, defining callback types, registration functions, initialization, transmission, reception, confirmation functions, and main processing loop related to CAN interface abstraction.

methods.name: CanIf_RegisterRxIndicationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle received messages.

methods.name: CanIf_RegisterTxConfirmationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle transmission confirmations.

methods.name: CanIf_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a CAN message.

methods.name: CanIf_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms transmission of a CAN message.

methods.name: CanIf_MainFunction
methods.description: Main cyclic function for the CAN interface, handling periodic tasks.
